newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror may sell Tejon stake.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror may sell Tejon stake.

text.p: Tejon Ranch Co said it retained J.P. Morgan Securities Inc following Times Mirror Co's announcement it would consider a sale of all or part of its 32 percent interest in the company.

It said it would retain J.P. Morgan "to provide general corporate financial advice, including evaluating potential opportunities to expand the company's real estate developments and agricultural operations."
"We believe that J.P. Morgan is well positioned to advise Tejon based on its work with other large landowners," President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Stine said in a statement.
